**Sec. 8062 – National Intelligence Program (NIP) Budget Structure**
- Prohibits use of funds to modify NIP appropriations account structure, budget presentation (P-1, R-1, O-1), apportionment process, or allotment/obligation/disbursement process.
- Exception: mergers/changes at or below Expenditure Center level permitted if consistent with (a)(1)–(3).
- DNI and SecDef may jointly study alternative financial management processes for auditability/fiscal reporting; must include counterintelligence risk assessment.
- Upon developing proposals: provide to affected agencies, receive certifications, present to congressional defense/intelligence committees within 30 days of receiving all certifications.

**Sec. 8063 – Fisher Houses Transfer Authority**
- Up to $11,000,000 each from O&M Army, Navy, Air Force may be transferred to central Fisher House fund under 10 U.S.C. §2493(d).

**Sec. 8064 – Fisher House Foundation Grant**
- Appropriates $5,000,000 to DoD, available until expended, for a grant to Fisher House Foundation, Inc. for construction/furnishing of additional Fisher Houses. Requires SecDef determination of national interest.

**Sec. 8065 – Stennis Center Transfer**
- Up to $1,000,000 from O&M Navy to John C. Stennis Center Trust Fund (2 U.S.C. §1105).

**Sec. 8066 – Navy Command and Control**
- Prohibits funds to modify C2 relationships giving Fleet Forces Command operational/administrative control of Pacific Fleet Navy forces. Status quo (Oct. 1, 2004) remains until written modification proposed to HAC/SAC. Modification implementable 30 days after notification unless objection received. Must not preclude INDOPACOM commander's operational requirements.

**Sec. 8067 – 10 U.S.C. §3601 Notices**
- Notices required under 10 U.S.C. §3601 (added by §804(a) of FY2023 NDAA) after enactment must be submitted concurrently to House and Senate Defense Appropriations Subcommittees.

**Sec. 8068 – Israeli Cooperative Programs**
- $500,000,000 from Procurement DW and RDT&E DW for Israeli Cooperative Programs:
  - $80,000,000: Iron Dome procurement (subject to U.S.-Israel Iron Dome Procurement Agreement, as amended)
  - $127,000,000: SRBMD program (including cruise missile defense R&D)
  - $40,000,000: SRBMD co-production (U.S. and Israel, subject to co-production agreement as amended)
  - $80,000,000: Arrow 3 Upper Tier co-production (subject to co-production agreement as amended)
  - $173,000,000: Arrow System Improvement Program (including long-range ground/airborne detection suite)
- Transfer authority in addition to other transfer authority in Act.

**Sec. 8069 – Prior Year Shipbuilding Cost Increases**
- $1,648,559,000 from SCN, available until Sept. 30, 2024, for prior year shipbuilding cost increases across 17 line items (Carrier Replacement, Virginia Class Submarine, DDG-51, LPD-17, Ship to Shore Connector, LCS, TAO Fleet Oiler, CVN Refueling Overhauls, Towing/Salvage/Rescue, T-AGOS Surtass). Largest: Carrier Replacement $624,600,000; T-AGOS Surtass $355,166,000.

**Sec. 8070 – Intelligence Activities Deemed Authorized**
- Funds for intelligence/intelligence-related activities deemed specifically authorized for purposes of 50 U.S.C. §3094(a)(1) until enactment of FY2024 Intelligence Authorization Act.

**Sec. 8071 – Reprogramming for New Starts**
- Prohibits reprogramming that creates/initiates new program/project/activity unless necessary immediately for national security and after written prior notification to congressional defense committees.

**Sec. 8072 – Nuclear Armed Interceptors**
- Prohibits funds for RDT&E, procurement, or deployment of nuclear-armed missile defense interceptors.

**Sec. 8073 – Ship Decommissioning Prohibition**
- Prohibits funds to decommission any Littoral Combat Ship, USS Germantown, or USS Tortuga.

**Sec. 8074 – Shipbuilding Reprogramming (31 U.S.C. §1553(b))**
- Any SCN subdivision deemed same purpose as prior-year SCN subdivisions; 1% limitation applies to total appropriation.

**Sec. 8075 – 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron**
- Prohibits reducing/disestablishing 53rd WRS operations below funded levels. Air Force must allow other missions during non-hurricane season.

**Sec. 8076 – Army TUAV Authority**
- Prohibits transferring TUAV R&D/acquisition/program authority from Army. Army retains responsibility/operational control of MQ-1C Gray Eagle.

**Sec. 8077 – Foreign Intelligence Information**
- Prohibits funds for integrating foreign intelligence information unless lawfully collected/processed during authorized activities. U.S. person information handled per Fourth Amendment/EO 12333.

**Sec. 8078 – ODNI Fund Availability**
- ODNI funds expire at end of current fiscal year, except: R&T available until Sept. 30, 2025; real property purchases until Sept. 30, 2026.
